card.name: Linking words after drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', a comma or an open bracket right after a drug name, often before a second drug. Also the 'yt' in 'bocytopenia' and 'This' starting a sentence after storage times.

modes.label: Joiner after a drug name
modes.description: 'and' or a comma follows a drug name in a combination product or pair of drugs.
